title: Failover: manual, automatic, and the promotion that must not happen twice

videos.script: The primary is gone. Promoting the standby takes one command. Deciding to is the job. {{decide}} You kill your primary as a crash would, check what the standby has, and promote it. It starts a new timeline and takes writes. {{promote}} Then the old primary reboots, and comes back as a primary. Two servers hand out the same order number to two customers. {{two}} You try to rewind it into a standby, and are refused, because a setting was off before the failure. So you rebuild it. {{rebuild}} Then the planned version: a switchover that loses nothing. {{switch}} And one more crash, this time rewound instead of rebuilt, with one setting left pointing at the wrong place. {{rewind}}
